name: insl
synopsis: void insl(unsigned short port, void addr[.count], unsigned long count);
description: insl performs input operations from a specified I/O port to memory, transferring a specified number of long words. It is used for low-level hardware port I/O and is primarily intended for kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port to read from

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: The memory address where data will be stored (array of count elements)

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of long words to transfer from the port

return_value.failure: May result in segmentation fault if permissions are not set via ioperm(2) or iopl(2)
